### The example of the auto-generated file fwu_mem_map.mak

```Makefile
#*******************************************************************************

#*******************************************************************************
#  PROJECT          Generic SW
#*******************************************************************************
#  Description      File contains make variables and definitions for FWU modules
#                   This file is automatically generated, any modification will
#                   be rewritten at the start of build!
#*******************************************************************************

# Module: FWU_BOOTMANAGER
# Make variables
FWU_BOOTMANAGER_START_ADDRESS ?= 8000000
FWU_BOOTMANAGER_END_ADDRESS ?= 80017ff
FWU_BOOTMANAGER_SIZE ?= 1800
# Definitions
defines += FWU_BOOTMANAGER_START_ADDRESS=UINT32_C(0x8000000)
defines += FWU_BOOTMANAGER_END_ADDRESS=UINT32_C(0x80017ff)
defines += FWU_BOOTMANAGER_SIZE=UINT32_C(0x1800)

# Module: FWU_LRO
# Make variables
FWU_LRO_START_ADDRESS ?= 8001800
FWU_LRO_END_ADDRESS ?= 8001fff
FWU_LRO_SIZE ?= 800
# Definitions
defines += FWU_LRO_START_ADDRESS=UINT32_C(0x8001800)
defines += FWU_LRO_END_ADDRESS=UINT32_C(0x8001fff)
defines += FWU_LRO_SIZE=UINT32_C(0x800)

# Module: FWU_PROGRAMMER
# Make variables
FWU_PROGRAMMER_START_ADDRESS ?= 8002000
FWU_PROGRAMMER_END_ADDRESS ?= 8005fff
FWU_PROGRAMMER_SIZE ?= 4000
# Definitions
defines += FWU_PROGRAMMER_START_ADDRESS=UINT32_C(0x8002000)
defines += FWU_PROGRAMMER_END_ADDRESS=UINT32_C(0x8005fff)
defines += FWU_PROGRAMMER_SIZE=UINT32_C(0x4000)

# Module: FWU_OTP_MEMORY
# Make variables
FWU_OTP_MEMORY_START_ADDRESS ?= 8006000
FWU_OTP_MEMORY_END_ADDRESS ?= 80067ff
FWU_OTP_MEMORY_SIZE ?= 800
# Definitions
defines += FWU_OTP_MEMORY_START_ADDRESS=UINT32_C(0x8006000)
defines += FWU_OTP_MEMORY_END_ADDRESS=UINT32_C(0x80067ff)
defines += FWU_OTP_MEMORY_SIZE=UINT32_C(0x800)

# Module: FWU_APP1
# Make variables
FWU_APP1_START_ADDRESS ?= 8006800
FWU_APP1_END_ADDRESS ?= 801f7ff
FWU_APP1_SIZE ?= 19000
# Definitions
defines += FWU_APP1_START_ADDRESS=UINT32_C(0x8006800)
defines += FWU_APP1_END_ADDRESS=UINT32_C(0x801f7ff)
defines += FWU_APP1_SIZE=UINT32_C(0x19000)

# Module: FWU_PROCESS_DATA

FWU_PROCESS_DATA_END_ADDRESS ?= 801ffff
FWU_PROCESS_DATA_SIZE ?= 800
# Definitions
defines += FWU_PROCESS_DATA_START_ADDRESS=UINT32_C(0x801f800)
defines += FWU_PROCESS_DATA_END_ADDRESS=UINT32_C(0x801ffff)
defines += FWU_PROCESS_DATA_SIZE=UINT32_C(0x800)
```
